snippet.title: Serene Seasons: Minecraft Cinematic Mod Showcase [up to 1.21.1]
snippet.description:
Serene Seasons adds dynamic seasons to Minecraft, changing foliage and allowing Winter snow in new biomes. Seasons also affect crops, weather, and other aspects of the game!


More info on the Mod page: 
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/serene-seasons
https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons

Mods and Shaders I’ve featured, used to create my videos, or find interesting: 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17YM612KJTSq5BOpv0_5pQDtknQg_Cl8qTRsdcEtBD7U/edit?usp=sharing

🎵 Background Music: 

Empire Seasons - Dan Henig

0:00 Intro Trailer
0:31 Mod Info
1:00 Calendar
1:17 Calendar Crafting
1:24 Season Sensor
1:44 Season Sensor Crafting
1:51 Spring
2:19 Summer
2:36 Autumn
3:01 Winter
3:21 Tropical Seasons
3:28 Wet Season
3:59 Dry Season
4:26 Outro

Disclaimer: If you’re the creator of the mod and there’s anything in the video that you'd like to discuss, feel free to contact me!
